full_judgment: 7. Mr. Muhammad Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the High Court Division erred in reversing the reasoned judgment of the appellate Court. He further submits that the High Court Division did not consider the fact that L.A. Case No.  of 1935-36 acquired only 08 acres of land which was confirmed by local investigation report. As such the High Court Division erred in not decreeing the remainder of the suit land in favour of the petitioner. He lastly submits that the dismissal of the entire suit was therefore illegal and the judgment and order of the High Court Division is liable to be set aside.
